name: Canon status
description: How authoritative a record is within its world.

codes.definition: Accepted as true by the world owner.
Deliberately outside the accepted history (what-ifs, alternate takes).
Authored by a person and awaiting review.
Produced by a procedural or AI generator and not yet promoted.
Created during play by a participant other than the world owner.
No longer part of the world but kept for history.
